name: sensorOutOfDateCount
definition: The number of endpoint agents in scope that the vendor reports as running an out-of-date agent version (needing an agent update).
population: the agents registered to the connected endpoint-protection tenant; every agent the read lists, or the vendor's own total for the tenant
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete, successful read of the tenant's agent population that states how many need an agent update (0 when none). A response that does not carry the figure, an error or refused answer, or a tenant with no agents cannot show 0 and is not measured.
citations: safeguards/epp/halcyon/sensorOutOfDateCount.py (Halcyon public OpenAPI, GET /search/devices/metrics, DeviceMetrics.need_updates; the vendor does not publish what version it measures against, so the figure is the vendor's as given)
safeguards/epp/sentinelone/sensorOutOfDateCount.py (existing implementation; counts agents inside a 15-day window whose isUpToDate is not true; not reviewed for this entry)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Halcyon transform can emit it. The meaning is the key name made precise; the other implementations of this name were not reviewed for this entry, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Vendor-defined: the version an agent is compared against is the vendor's own rule.
